selection: All nine head-only results of the frozen original training report; exact selected-track pose frames from prior native PFCH probes. No new or held-out examples selected.
metricsFrozenBeforeMeasurement: valid observed coverage and missing/invalid samples
first-to-last SO(3) geodesic angle only when both requested endpoints are valid
maximum pairwise SO(3) geodesic angle within each contiguous valid requested-sample run
sum of consecutive geodesic step angles within each valid run (noise-sensitive diagnostic)
minimum of the two sides excursion/net-angle as separate within-head preference diagnostics; no fitted weights or thresholds
missingEvidence: No filling missing rotations with identity/frontal orientation and no interpolation over explicit gaps. Report raw time gaps and sample validity.
limits: Diagnostic feature audit on already reviewed training judgments. Not independent accuracy, calibrated confidence, camera-motion disambiguation, new retrieval or a production ranking policy.
rangePolicy: Analyze half-open [start,end) exactly as the core head classifier. Cached exclusive-end records remain in replay provenance but cannot supply motion evidence.
rotationValidation: Use the existing core criterion: all entries finite, row orthogonality and determinant errors <=0.002. Invalid matrices become missing evidence, without repair or projection.
